title: QUINTA: Reflexive Sensibility For Responsible AI Research and Data-Driven Processes
findings: The proposed QUINTA analytical pathway successfully identified and amplified the voices of marginalized communities within the #metoo movement that were otherwise overlooked. This included specific religious groups, as evidenced by the detection of hashtag derivatives like '#metooblackchurch' and '#metoomuslim', which were more prevalent in the QUINTA analysis compared to a standard approach.

measurement_description: The paper's proposed framework (QUINTA) was used to measure the visibility and detection of marginalized intersectional communities, including religious groups, within the online discourse of the #metoo social movement. This was achieved by analyzing hashtag derivatives to identify communities that were not prominent in mainstream analyses.
